I would love to work with you and help you navigate whatever concerns/difficulties you are experiencing in your life’s journey. Personal Statement: As a young adult you have a lot of worries: sorting out career, relationships, setting up your future. All of that alone can be stress enough, but add depression, anxiety, and the psychological struggles that come with that stress it gets even worse. While your struggles are very real, it can be difficult to get anyone to take them seriously. People your age don't have any more insight than you do about it, and older adults don't remember how frightening these struggles can be. They don't remember feeling like you're behind on the imaginary timeline, or feeling less accomplished than you should be. You aren't alone. Therapy may seem like an odd choice for "normal" stress via life changes, but it can be a great place to think things through. A therapist can offer guidance that helps you realize that you're not any more or less than your peers, your life isn't going to be forever affected by your choices, and can assist you in learning to better handle stress. It's important to not underestimate the stress brought about by normal life transitions. You and I can work together to find creative solutions in a space that takes your worries seriously, despite how "simple" they may seem from the outside. Sometimes a parent or a friend just won't cut it. An unbiased party can really help in you finding your own way.

Personal Statement: All of our services are outpatient - office based treatment. Our patients are initially seen to determine if they are suffering from Opioid Use Disorder and if they are appropriate for Buprenorphine Treatment with Subutex or Suboxone. Patients undergo an induction and stabilization period that will require more frequent visits but our expectation is that patients can be stable with monthly medication visits. In addition our patients attend a group therapy session once a month or more frequently if they are having difficulty with compliance. Patients are given random drug screens and pills are counted at least at each medication visit. At Buprenorphine Treatment Centers, Inc., our primary focus is the use of medically prescribed Buprenorphine (Subutex and Suboxone) to eliminate cravings and the symptoms of withdrawal and thereby allow our patients to lead normal lives. With the appropriate daily use of Subutex or Suboxone our patients can return to the way they felt and functioned before they developed a problem with opioids or narcotics. If you are struggling with narcotics then you likely are not enjoying life and may be spending much of your time thinking about how you will avoid withdrawal and cravings. You may also find yourself obtaining drugs illegally which puts you at risk for legal complications as well. Your opiate use has probably affected family, friendships and employment. Help is available! With the use of buprenorphine, which is the active ingredient in Subutex and one of the active ingredients in Suboxone, you can lead a normal life without the fear of withdrawals, cravings and without the risk of breaking the law. We want our patients to be happy and lead productive lives with satisfaction at work, love and play. If you are looking for a Buprenorphine Treatment Center, we are now in 4 locations: Gainesville, Orange Park (Jacksonville area), Perry and Palatka.

Personal Statement: I love helping people heal and reclaim their most authentic Self. I find that most mental health diagnoses are a cluster of symptoms related to the core issue of having lost a secure relationship with yourself. Most of us have had life experiences that have caused us to internalize negative beliefs, create protective mechanisms, and develop strategies to manipulate our environments so that we can feel safer and more secure in the world. All of this distances us from our true selves and leads to inauthentic be-ing in our lives. Without authenticity, it is difficult to feel truly safe, satisfied and have healthy relationships. I like to start with the Enneagram to identify negative beliefs and protective mechanisms. Next, I use IFS to guide internal conversations with the various parts of you that protect you and hold those negative beliefs. Finally, EMDR can help your system process/digest your experiences and free you to move on and live an authentically you life. The therapy I provide allows people to shed that which no longer serves them and instead, use their energy to create the life they want. This process is incredibly freeing and empowering. I also provide spiritual and energy healing services, for those who are interested. I have information about those offerings on my website.

Personal Statement: I work with individuals and families who have experienced trauma, whether from a single event or a series of distressing experiences. Trauma often disrupts daily life in various ways. Sometimes the impact is more noticeable, such as avoiding places associated with the trauma, while at other times it is more subtle, like persistent feelings of unease, difficulty focusing, or challenges in relationships. Many people affected by trauma hope to forget these painful experiences and move forward, seeking healing and resolution. What we know about trauma is that, while it’s natural to want to avoid thinking about the event or events, our minds and bodies benefit from addressing them in a safe, trauma-informed environment. This doesn’t mean clients are expected to recount every detail of what happened. Rather, we work toward healing together, gently confronting the trauma’s impact. I have had the honor of working with many individuals and families who have experienced trauma and have witnessed their healing. I use a blend of evidence-based approaches, such as EMDR, TF-CBT, and DBT. I hold deep hope for individuals who have experienced trauma and believe that together we can create new paths forward. I look forward to talking with you.

Personal Statement: I view relationship problems from a systemic model. Meaning that I take into account environmental factors, relationship factors, family of origin, biological, mental, and spiritual factors when creating a treatment plan. From this approach new understanding and new solutions are opened up for the relationship. Too often in our problem solving we try the same thing over and over and when it does not work we just try the same thing harder. If you find yourself stuck in that kind of negative cycle just know that you are not alone and that there is help available. I work from an evidence based approach called EFT in a intensive format. I am a certified Emotionally Focus Couples Therapy (EFT) therapist who specializes in working with highly distressed couples. Through my experience I have found that the most effective way to work with highly distressed couples is through a couple intensive which is a full day session. This allows us the time needed to go deep enough to make progress. My practice is structured in a way to help couples make progress quickly and effectively.  During a one or two day intensive couples can accomplish the same gains that normally take 7-14 weeks of hourly therapy.  Not every problem can be addressed in a 50 min session once a week. Couple intensives are an alternative to the one hour a week treatment plan.
